source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: Only 6 of the 18 holes traced. No hole map was found, the club's other course shares the photos and couldn't be told apart, part of the grounds runs off the west edge of the photos and some of it looks overgrown, so most greens couldn't be matched to holes. Hole numbers are a best fit to the card's pars and lengths, not a known order
unsure.5: number guessed from length (453 yd par 4) and because a par 3 follows it; the map already had this hole without a number
unsure.6: number guessed from length (par 3, about 177 yd) right after the hole before; the map already had this hole without a number
unsure.12: number and direction of play guessed from the fairway shape and length
unsure.14: number and tee guessed; fairway runs west to a green the map already had
unsure.16: numbered from the card: the only par 3 of this length next to the 17th tee; the map already had this hole without a number
unsure.17: numbered from the card: the only hole over 600 yd; the map already had this hole without a number
